label: Code story

kinds.title: Opening card on a dark terminal-style frame.
kinds.code: A code listing in an editor window; chosen lines light up while the voice talks about them.
kinds.diff: Before and after code: removed lines strike through, added lines open in place, and a line that only changed shows its changed words, like a pull request.
kinds.tree: The files a change touched, each with green and red bars for lines added and removed.
kinds.terminal: Commands typed into a terminal, then their output: test runs, builds, installs.
kinds.checklist: A checklist that types itself and ticks each item: release notes, steps done.
kinds.cta: Closing card: the one action viewers should take, with a button.

fields.code: The code, as it appears in the source. Up to 18 lines of 72 characters.
fields.lang: The language or file name shown on the window bar, e.g. "app.js".
fields.highlight: JSON list of line numbers to light up, e.g. [3, 4].
fields.before: The code before the change, copied from the source diff.
fields.after: The code after the change, copied from the source diff.
fields.file: The file name shown on the window bar.
fields.files: JSON list of changed files: [{ "path": "src/app.js", "added": 12, "removed": 3 }]. Up to 12.
fields.lines: JSON list of terminal lines: [{ "cmd": "npm test" }, { "out": "✓ 42 passed" }]. Up to 14.
fields.items: JSON list of checklist items: ["Faster start-up", { "text": "Dark mode", "done": false }]. Up to 8.
fields.text: One supporting sentence under the panel.

description: Software changes told on screen: code listings with lines that light up, before and after diffs, the files a pull request touched, terminal sessions that type themselves, and checklists that tick off, then the call to action. For release notes, pull request videos, bug reports and agent session recaps.
